scope: One original actor RIGHT upper-arm/sleeve only. No other part, animation key, in-between, atlas, runtime output, or integration.
finite_gate: A separate parent authorization must name this exact v2 prompt/input set and allow one call. Until then do not generate.

validated_contract.core_partial_inspection: PASS_SOURCE_DRIVEN_CORE_MODEL_ADJUSTMENT_TECHNICAL_INSPECTION_ONLY; actual art and all motion remain unqualified.

tooling_v4.behavior: one uniform raw-to-bone-rest calibration maps actual observed proximal/distal raw points to local [0,0] and [0,200]; final 3D fixed South camera projection occurs later in baker.

part.ownership: Actor RIGHT upper arm and ivory sleeve; shoulder cap underlap through elbow cuff overlap. In South front view it appears viewer-left.

local_bone_plane.orientation: straight unforeshortened local Y axis; arbitrary full-canvas visual placement is not a world/screen attachment point
local_bone_plane.width_source: visual estimate from canonical South sleeve; approximate style/shape guidance only.

part.attachment: Actor RIGHT shoulder attaches to the calibrated core cloth-cap convention in part-contract-v3. The guide’s proximal end is only a model layout hypothesis, not a measured core/limb source landmark.
part.actual_landmarks: Natural shoulder and elbow coordinates are pending future raw original. Record method observed_original, uncertainty, evidence, byte/RGBA hashes, and one uniform calibration; no invented or guide-derived coordinates.
part.camera: Final 26.565 degree fixed South camera is applied by v4 baker. Do not pre-foreshorten guide/source texture or double-apply projection.
part.source_calibration: Only one immutable uniform scale/rotation/translation after actual raw inspection. No anisotropic scale, crop, alpha cleanup, tracing, source edits, or per-frame fit.

inputs_exact_order_if_parent_authorizes.role: Canonical South identity, neutral pose, costume and body-scale authority.
Established painterly style, material rendering, palette and northwest-light authority; not direction or global scale authority.
Actual core after sealed uniform static calibration; cloth weave, ivory tone and actual shoulder-cap overlap/style reference only. Preview is not a source edit or final art.
MODEL_ONLY local bone-plane geometry: actor RIGHT upper arm silhouette, unforeshortened 200-unit shoulder-to-elbow axis, proximal/distal overlap. No appearance authority.

guide.definition: Clean guide is a single geometry-only gray sleeve on transparent full canvas; no identity or appearance authority.

pose_plan.use: defines fixed South camera and model lengths; the guide is the local 200-unit bone plane, not projected key art.

approval_state.part_acceptance: pending actual raw and sidecar inspection
